caption:
The plan for what goes inside the Ghost: a Raspberry Pi 4, a round 1.28" LCD for the eye, an I2S mic and amp, a 16-LED ring and three servos.

The software is already written. Wake word and speech-to-text run offline on the Pi. The personality is Claude, and it writes little emotion tags into its replies, [happy], [curious], [worried], that will change the eye, the light colour and how it moves.

Printing comes next. Follow to see it come together.

Fan project. Destiny and the Ghost belong to Bungie.
